user_story: As a guest, I want the system to reject an invalid date format so that only correctly formatted dates are accepted.

positive.title: Valid date format with valid month and day
steps: Input the date '2023-10-01' into the date field
positive.expected_result: The system accepts the date without any errors

positive.title: Valid date format with single digit day and month
steps: Input the date '2023-1-1' into the date field
positive.expected_result: The system accepts the date without any errors

positive.title: Valid date format with different months
steps: Input the date '2023-02-28' into the date field
positive.expected_result: The system accepts the date without any errors

negative.title: Invalid date format with letters
steps: Input the date '2023-AB-CD' into the date field
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the date with an error message

negative.title: Invalid date format with incorrect delimiter
steps: Input the date '2023/10/01' into the date field
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the date with an error message

negative.title: Invalid date format with missing year
steps: Input the date '10-01' into the date field
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the date with an error message

edge.title: Valid leap year date
steps: Input the date '2024-02-29' into the date field
edge.expected_result: The system accepts the date without any errors

edge.title: Edge case with maximum valid date
steps: Input the date '9999-12-31' into the date field
edge.expected_result: The system accepts the date without any errors

edge.title: Invalid date format with extra characters
steps: Input the date '2023-10-01abc' into the date field
edge.expected_result: The system rejects the date with an error message
